Final Round

Pop Punk · Chicago 2003 → Austin, TX

Bio

Final Round is a pop punk band formed in Chicago in 2003, now based in Austin, TX. Recorded in Chicago at The Bombshelter and produced by Final Round and Dan Precision. Everything is human-made, no AI. A new album is coming in Spring 2027.

Lineup: Dan Lowes (bass, vocals) · Matt Hampson (guitar, vocals) · Jake Smith (drums)
Label: Arch Rival Records (distributed by DistroKid)
